name: Input Buffer
description: Practice tool for click patterns. Buffer and Snap only work in practice mode or from a start position.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns Buffer and Snap on or off. Your best run is still saved while off.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description:
Buffer: hold early presses until the player can act.
Snap to best run: a click that comes within the snap window before a click from your best run is held and fired at the right moment. Every other click works as normal. Your furthest attempt from each start position is saved as the best run automatically.
Buffer and Snap only work in practice mode or from a start position.

buffer-frames.name: Buffer Frames
buffer-frames.description: How many physics steps a press is held while the player cannot act yet. 0 disables buffering.

snap-window.name: Snap Window
snap-window.description: Snap mode: how many physics steps before a click from your best run your click may come and still be moved onto it. At 240 steps per second, 4 steps is about one frame at 60 FPS.

toggle-key.name: Toggle Hotkey
toggle-key.description: Turn the mod on or off. Only works in practice mode or from a start position.

more-help-key.name: More Help Hotkey
more-help-key.description: Add one step to the buffer (Buffer mode) or snap window (Snap mode).

less-help-key.name: Less Help Hotkey
less-help-key.description: Remove one step from the buffer (Buffer mode) or snap window (Snap mode).
